subject.title: macOS: Gateway daemon PATH excludes user bin dirs (nix, bun, local, etc.)

question: Should macOS Gateway LaunchAgents keep the canonical minimal PATH, gain an explicit operator opt-in for user-bin directories, or include user-bin directories by default?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and service-path policy intentionally harden macOS LaunchAgent command resolution, while the requested behavior improves Nix/Bun/local tool discovery; automation should not choose that security/product tradeoff.

options.title: Keep minimal default, add explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the current safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only with schema, docs, doctor, and security tests.

options.title: Change the macOS default
options.body: Include Darwin user-bin directories by default, accepting the broader command-resolution surface and requiring fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Decline service PATH expansion
options.body: Leave daemon PATH policy unchanged and direct users to existing exec PATH controls, explicit binary paths, or standard system install locations.

recommendation.title: Keep minimal default, add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the current safe default and add a maintainer-approved service PATH opt-in only with schema, docs, doctor, and security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the closest current maintainer-side signal on adjacent managed service PATH precedence in the related pnpm PATH PR.
